simulate_gaussian_noise_image: simulate Gaussian noise on a color image using the numba JIT compiled _simulate function
create_gaussian_noise_model: create a GaussianNoiseModel with custom intensity_constant mean and sigma parameters for sensor noise
apply_noise_to_image: apply Gaussian noise to a numpy image array using the GaussianNoiseModel apply method
check_valid_sensor_type: check if the GaussianNoiseModel is valid for a given SensorType using is_valid_sensor_type
build_gaussian_noise_cpu_impl: build a GaussianNoiseModelCPUImpl instance to directly simulate noise on image arrays
